title: Vegan Thai Larb
description: A plant-based twist on the classic Thai dish, using crispy tempeh instead of meat. This vegan larb is spicy, sour, and sweet all at once.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the tempeh and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion, mushrooms, bell pepper, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the lime juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, chili flakes, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the cilantro and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the larb hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles if desired.
